messages:
maya: Nightly eval alert — recall at topk=20 dropped ~12% for RAG testset on prod index after quantized reranker rollout (reranker-v2 -> reranker-v2-q8). Seen mostly on long-context cohorts. Any quick thoughts? :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly-eval | rerank recall drop detected | model: reranker-v2-q8 | delta_recall@20: -0.12 | failures: 73/600 | https://ci.internal/evals/1965432101 :warning:

leila: @maya can you paste 1-2 failing queries + expected vs returned ids so we can inspect?

maya: pasted two examples below

maya: Query: "How to revoke API keys for third-party apps"
maya: Expected top-3 ids: [d_124, d_890, d_57]
maya: Got top-3: [d_890, d_57, d_783]

maya: Query: "Configuring VPC peering for private deploy"
maya: Expected: [d_211, d_319, d_77]
maya: Got: [d_319, d_77, d_402]

oliver: rolled reranker-v2-q8 to canary yesterday ~22:30 UTC, quantization used: dynamic per-layer + minmax int8. rolling back to float32 on canary now. :+1:

zach: linking PR that changed scoring tie-breaker: https://github.com/redwood/reranker/pull/842
zach: small last-layer norm scaling tweak in scoring pipeline.

leila: could be quantization-induced rank flips, or the tie-breaker interacting with tiny score deltas. @oliver can you run local rerank eval with float32 weights, and q8 but with tie-breaker disabled?

oliver: running now. command:

```
python eval/run_rerank_eval.py --model reranker-v2 --model-quant q8 --tie-breaker off --topk 100 --dataset rag-nightly-2026-03
```

oliver: ETA ~12m

eval-bot: quick remind: index used = prod-2026-03; embedding hashing version = v3; no index rebuild between runs.

oliver: results: float32 baseline recall@20 = 0.78; reranker-v2-q8 recall@20 = 0.66; reranker-v2-q8 with tie-breaker off recall@20 = 0.77
oliver: so tie-breaker flips are amplifying quantization noise. :thinking_face:

maya: wow that's pretty telling. Fix options: 1) revert tie-breaker change, 2) tweak quantization per-layer clipping, 3) add small score-stabilization jitter. Thoughts?

leila: pref revert tie-breaker in next patch and push improved quant config as follow-up. Need a hotfix for prod. @zach can infra patch canary rollback to prod quickly?

zach: opening emergency revert PR now, tagging infra oncall. If tests pass, canary->prod rollback in ~30m. @leila please prepare a regression test to block future rollouts.

maya: I'll add 8 failing queries as unit tests to rerank-regression suite. quick snippet I'll add:

```
# tests/rerank/test_quant_stability.py
def test_misrank_examples():
    failures = load_failures('tests/fixtures/misrank_examples.json')
    assert rerank(failures[0]).topk_ids[:3] == failures[0]['expected_top3']
```

maya: pushing in ~10.

oliver: thanks — logging summary to #incidents once rollback is underway, will include metric diffs and brief timeline.

leila: follow-up: pair with research to run post-quantization calibration on a heldout set; should reduce these flips systematically.

maya: noted. thanks all :rocket:
